title: Market Targeting Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 10
description:
Zoya has three groups of buyers, and only one small kitchen. Nani can't make laddoos for everyone, every day. So which group should Laddoo Lab serve first? In this animated lesson we use Laddoo Lab, a millet laddoo brand from Bengaluru, to understand market targeting.

You will see Kotler and Armstrong's definition of a target market, then watch Zoya score her three segments live on size and growth, competition, and fit with what Laddoo Lab does best, until tiffin parents win and busy parents become the target (example figures). We cover the four targeting strategies, mass (undifferentiated), differentiated, concentrated (niche) and micromarketing, and see why a small brand starts concentrated. Then we see each strategy at work today, in a salt maker, a bank, a small bakery and a food delivery app. We also look at the human side honestly: focus puts money and effort where it works, but saying no loses some buyers, depending on one group is risky, and marketing to children needs extra care.

This is Episode 10 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
